blocks.title: Red flags
blocks.text: Red flags aisi alamaat hain ke maakhaz ghair motabar ho sakta hai: likhne wale ki maloomat nahi, sansani khez surkhiyan, ya hawale nahi.

Baghair wazeh likhne wale ya rabte ki maloomat ki website ghair motabar ho sakti hai. Ghair tasdeeq shuda maakhaz par bharosa ghalat maloomat phailata aur kharab faisle karwata hai, to hamesha maakhaz ki tasdeeq karein, likhne wale ki sanad dekhein aur tarafdari ya sansani dekhein (Be cautious).

blocks.explanation: Likhne wale ka naam ya rabta nahi, sansani khez surkhi, aur hawale nahi.

items: Red flags: likhne wala nahi, sansani khez surkhiyan, hawale nahi.
